author: reek
body: Writes a sector and reads it back. The disk starts with a known byte at offset 0 of sector 5; the test overwrites sector 5 with a distinct pattern, reads it back through the normal read path, and checks the pattern survived -- and that an untouched sector (6) still holds its original byte. A driver that wrote nothing, or wrote the wrong sector, fails one of the two.

author: reek
body: A two-sector write, to prove the multi-sector count path stores consecutive sectors rather than one sector twice.
